## Grain barn (2026-11-04, creative preview)
- Design: settlement/designs/grainbarn.ts. Place with `place.ts grainbarn 291 732 south --y 68 --no-clear`. Region fixes: `settlement/scripts/patch.ts ../designs/grainbarn.ts 291 68 732 "[[box]]"`.
- Boiler startup (tested):
  1. Turn the clutch lever (297,86,759) ON.
  2. Crank the hand crank (297,79,763) for about 10 s until the engine runs at 64 RPM.
  3. Turn the lever OFF. Capacity 16384 SU; load about 1700.
- Pipe lesson: a pipe end only draws from water if the pipe has a single connection. Corner pipes facing water get recomputed and lose the open end.
- Millstones: powered by a cog beside them (millstones take no shaft from above). A hopper underneath empties them. Tested: wheat in, flour out.
- Field: a bearing with a radial-chassis arm (range must be 1) and 14 harvesters. Tested: harvests and replants. Wheat collects in the end barrels on the arm.
- Not tested: the mixer (the basin needs water piped in) and the smoking fan bake.
- Vaults cannot stand vertically; each silo is 3 stacked 3x3x3 vaults.
- Field to mill (tested). The arm (slowed to 8 RPM by the user's gear train, kept in keep-grainbarn.json) carries an end interface (325,78,741) that docks with the fixed one (327,78,741) once per turn.
  - Brass funnels sort the load: wheat goes to belt B1, which runs south underground; the seed funnel is set to seeds and they go to the seed chest (329,76,741).
  - B2 climbs into the hall and drops into the hopper chain at z759. Millstone 325 takes the wheat first; 322 gets the overflow.
  - Belts were reversed with straight-through gearboxes at (321,76,741) and (328,76,754).
- Millstones now split the wheat evenly: hoppers along z760 fill a double chest (323..324,80,759), with one hopper under each half. The fan drive was moved under the floor, and the fan/campfire/depot are now at z761/762/763.
